name: praxis
description: A lean, proportional engineering framework with optional stations, evidence-matched assurance, and durable state only when work must survive.

interface.shortDescription: A lean engineering framework for capable agents
interface.longDescription: Praxis is one loop with optional stations — EXPLORE, DECIDE, CONTRACT, PLAN, EXECUTE, PROVE, DELIVER — where each skill loads only when its activity is present and ordinary work stays direct. Its assurance ladder adds delegation or independent review only for a concrete ownership advantage or named risk. Native messages carry coordination; durable artifacts exist when a named future consumer needs information that source, Git, tests, or an owning record cannot reconstruct. Plans and plan-governed pull requests retain human gates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the one Praxis skill whose engineering activity is present, and keep ordinary work direct when no skill boundary is needed.
